notes.title: Update Ver1.11
notes.notes: Fixed an issue where the leaderboard was not displayed correctly.

notes.title: Supports Steam Input (various controllers)
notes.notes:
[h1]Now supports Steam Input.[/h1]
See here for settings:
https://partner.steamgames.com/doc/features/steam_controller/getting_started_for_players
[b][i]It is also SteamDeck compatible, although it has not yet been officially certified.[/i][/b]

notes.title: Full release has been made.
notes.notes:
[b]We have moved from Early Access to full release. [/b]
Thank you for your support so far. 
We look forward to your continued support.

[i]With the full release, the "Leaderboard" has been unlocked. 
Play the rank stages and upload your grade! (Uploading is done automatically)
[/i]

notes.title: EA Ver.03
notes.notes:
EA Ver.03
・Fixed an issue where the numbers on the result screen were sometimes not reflected correctly.
・Episode mode: Relaxed standards for each level.
・Practice Mode: The time limit for rank stages has been increased to ease grade judgment.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44869743/c8ff004ec3534f0b501e863ff49ff2f35b02af93.jpg[/img]

notes.title: EA Ver.02
notes.notes:
EA Ver.02
- Optimized operation at high refresh rates.
- Fixed a problem with keyboard operation.
- Fixed a bug in the "Retire" dialog.
